overview: This file traces Japanese overseas shortwave broadcasting and U.S. monitoring of its propaganda in 1940. It includes program bulletins, broadcast transcripts, consular reports, correspondence arranging Ambassador Grew’s tribute to Prince Iyesato Tokugawa, a report on restrictions on shipboard radios, and inquiries about Japan’s planned broadcasting expansion.
interest: Broadcast schedules and listener letters sit alongside U.S. assessments of propaganda and transcripts aimed at American audiences.
